[[File:Anagram reference - Blondie in his poncho in The Good, the Bad and the Ugly.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Blondie (Clint Eastwood), 1966.]]
'''Blondie''' is the drifter played by Clint Eastwood in Sergio Leone's 1966 western ''The Good, the Bad and the Ugly'', where he is "the Good". The bandit Tuco (Eli Wallach), "the Ugly", gives him the nickname, and the mercenary [[Angel Eyes (The Good, the Bad and the Ugly)|Angel Eyes]] (Lee Van Cleef) is "the Bad".<ref name="wp-gbu">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Good,_the_Bad_and_the_Ugly The Good, the Bad and the Ugly], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027184439/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Good,_the_Bad_and_the_Ugly Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.</ref> Blondie is the third of Eastwood's roles known together as the Man with No Name, after "Joe" and "Manco".<ref name="wp-mwnn">[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Man_with_No_Name Man with No Name], Wikipedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027184609/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Man_with_No_Name Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.</ref>

== Star Wars CCG ==
[[File:SE-L-debnoli.gif|thumb|left|200px|[[Debnoli]] ([[Special Edition]])|link=Debnoli]]
The [[Special Edition]] card [[Debnoli]] is an anagram of Blondie, and the anagram list gives the film as the relation.<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 200. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref> The same set has [[Gela Yeens]], an anagram of Angel Eyes, which the list marks "(BAD)", and [[Bron Burs]], an anagram of the artist [[Rob Burns]], which it marks "(UGLY)".<ref name="geo">[https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], oocities.org (GeoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.</ref> The three lores tie the cards together:
<blockquote>Good-natured patron of Mos Eisley cantina, until the Empire impounded his starship. Expert marksman. Seeking revenge on the Empire.</blockquote>
<blockquote>Bad-tempered smuggler. Makes a few credits more helping Jabba collect debts. Highly regarded for his uncanny anticipation in battle. Searching for Debnoli.</blockquote>
<blockquote>Ugly scars cover this former commando from southern Nentan. Likes to be on his own. Crack shot. Off and on partner of Debnoli. Relies on intuition to survive.</blockquote>
The first is [[Debnoli]], the second [[Gela Yeens]] and the third [[Bron Burs]].
